digest.component_or_area: outbound type mapping and configuration layer
propositions: Type mapping must be config-driven with per-project type_map axis and SKIP sentinel, mirroring S2 status_map pattern
Fail-closed validation on undecided syncable types must fire once up-front before the mutation loop, not lazily per-ticket
Round-trip type preservation requires symmetric rebar-type: annotation labels (stamp on lossy collapse, recover on inbound) reverse-map-free
Per-project excluded sync set must union EXCLUDED_SYNC_TYPES with types mapped to SKIP, replacing single global set in consumers
Type mapping parameter must thread through all three OutboundMapper implementations and both field mappers without signature mismatch
Rebar-type: prefix must be added to all four internal label filter tuples to prevent spurious tag syncs and remove mutations
